full_judgment: 5. The trial court decreed the suit on February 16, 1981. On appeal, being Title Appeal No. 56 of 1981, the Additional District Judge, 2nd Court, Dhaka set aside the trial court's judgment and dismissed the suit. Plaintiff-respondent moved the High Court Division against the judgment of the first appellate court. The learned Judges of the High Court Division who heard the aforesaid revisional case set aside the judgment and decree of the first appellate court and remanded the case to that court for rehearing the appeal on merit according to law.
